nts.note: Anycast, under 10 ms from every test point. Time services fall under the website terms, no stated rate limit. Lost about half its answers from GCP europe-west9 and europe-west1 in 2026-11.
NTS-KE names NTP servers by address in 194.58.200.0/21, port 4123. Free for anyone. Alt hosts answered NTS-KE from Europe on 2026-11-10.

alt.note: Another network block than ptbtime1 to 3.

nts.note: National metrology institute, Germany. Free, no registration, rate limiting off. Alt hosts answered NTS-KE from Europe on 2026-11-10.

alt.note: Anycast, stratum 2, called experimental by TimeNL. Under 10 ms from every GCP test point on 2026-11-10.

nts.note: TimeNL / SIDN Labs. Fair use with a 1024 s poll interval, no hard-coding in mass-market products; the runner polls far more often, and spreading queries over the alt hosts does not change that, since the policy is per client. In the default set of images before 2026-11; left it for its terms.
National metrology institute, Austria, stratum 1. Public, no limits stated, no liability for outages.

University of Zagreb FER, stratum 1 GNSS. Public and free; large users should run their own secondary. Rejects stale cookies with the kiss code NTS and a zero octet; keeps cookies 3 to 4 h. NTS-KE timed out from all six non-EU GCP regions on 2026-11-10, so eu only.

Meta, stratum 1 GNSS. NTS-KE names time.meta.com as its NTP server. Live and free, no usage policy found. Smears leap seconds over about 18 h. Short-lived KE certificates (renewed weekly in 2026-11). 0 answers from one home line on 2026-11-08, 16/16 elsewhere.
Paris Observatory (LNE-OP), stratum 2. Open to all; regular users are asked to email the operator first.
University of Cambridge UIS, stratum 2. Terms not public (the NTP help page is staff-only), so ask first. ntp2.cam.ac.uk (Department of Engineering) did not answer NTS-KE and is left out.

Manitoba Internet Exchange, Winnipeg, stratum 1 GPS. Its NTP page (archived 2026-06; the live site is down since 2026-10-21) says the cluster serves MBIX-connected networks and states no limits; time1.mbix.ca says it is in the public NTP pool and gives an NTS client config. Use outside MBIX networks is not stated, so ask. Steady -3 to -9 ms offset from far test points.

Wikstrom Telephone Company, Minnesota, stratum 1 GPS. Public NTP pool member, NTS client config published, no limits stated; the page does not name the operator. Offset -3 to -18 ms from far test points.
NIC.br with Observatorio Nacional time, stratum 1. Free and public; built for Brazil, foreign clients may be blocked for a while under load. b.st1.ntp.br did not answer NTS-KE and is left out.

Global Entry Systems, Colorado, stratum 2 with a GPS/PPS stratum 1 upstream. Terms not readable (site returns 403), so ask. 16/16 from all six non-EU GCP regions on 2026-11-10; 125 ms from Tokyo, 172 ms from Sydney, 187 ms from Singapore, so not apac by the 180 ms rule. Not measured from Europe.
